title: Start-up branding
intro: Brand identity for a company filming and editing promotional video for real estate agencies, built around the founder's initials. A newcomer that needed to look like it already belonged.
brief: As a start-up pitching to large, established agencies, the company needed to look professional but approachable from day one. The founder also wanted his initials, ME, in both the company name and the brand.
did: I built the mark from the founder's initials, turning the m into arches that read as doorways or windows: a quiet nod to the properties the company films. The shape around it doubles as a frame, so footage of an interior can sit inside the logo and the brand becomes a literal view into a space.
coverAlt: ME Huizenpromotie logo framing an interior photo
